0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (6-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) as the Nets look to build on a win in their last game, while Atlanta enters on a three-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4 to the Hawks, most recently a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026. Egor Demin is out for the Nets with a leg bruise, and the Hawks are without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
